package: Lab workspaces, compute qualification, and research provenance
delivery_revision: Working tree; central integration ledger records the final committed revision

verification.scope: Focused regression duration, not an application performance benchmark
real_local_process_checks: Actual numeric metric write and validated read
Actual retained trace write/read with a synthetic Slurm environment identity
Actual bounded local script snapshot transport during native submission review

independent_review.conclusion: No remaining P1/P2 findings in reviewed package scope
resolved_findings: Fresh native ownership and complete compute-observed submission/restart identity are required; numeric IDs alone remain unverified
Kubernetes Job UID is separate from Pod UID, automatic retries are disabled, and nonterminal/failed native outcomes remain visible
Result reads and writes use fully anchored no-follow private state directories
Persistent experiment bridges compare the full shared retained identity including restart generation; contradictory source cluster, submit epoch and script hash are rejected
Legacy source and caller-selected scheduler identity remain distinct in partial association metadata
Lexical integer cells remain exact, numeric filters use Decimal comparisons, incompatible ranges fail with diagnostics, and source units are not silently relabelled
Lab inventory refuses a different scheduler even when connection scope digests match

coverage.requirement: Reusable named lab/site workspace across Slurm, Kubernetes, IBM Spectrum LSF, OpenPBS, PBS Professional, HTCondor, and Flux
coverage.evidence: labs.validate/save/load and private atomic project storage; all seven native scheduler identifiers accepted
coverage.limits: This indexes explicit native connections and existing profile references; it does not replace the established Slurm profile configuration model

coverage.requirement: System login, billing account, scientific-job resources, and Heavy resources remain distinct
coverage.evidence: labs.defaults/defaults_for_workspace; account must belong to an explicit source-labelled association; independent job_defaults/heavy_defaults
coverage.limits: A visible or declared association is not spending authority, available allocation, a personal-account classification, or unlimited workstation resources

coverage.requirement: Bounded explicit cross-site pending-work inventory with connection scope and recovery feedback
coverage.evidence: labs.inventory and inventory_from_workspace; selected clients only; full authority digest match; disconnected/deferred/failed/blocked states; cancellation; finally closes transports
coverage.limits: Eight sites, 10000 retained rows, 30-second outer default budget; native commands retain their own timeout/output bounds; no global atomic snapshot or automatic background polling

coverage.requirement: Discovered account associations and allocation balances for every native scheduler
coverage.evidence: Existing governed Slurm Setup discovers actual sacctmgr memberships; lab requests preserve discovery or declaration source; inventory reports allocation limits unknown
coverage.block: Native account/credit/accounting APIs differ and are not implemented by this package for all schedulers
coverage.unblock: Implement and qualify explicit read-only association/balance adapters with site semantics and independent capability reporting; credentials alone do not fill this code gap

coverage.requirement: Optional reviewed tiny compute jobs test Python/imports, writable filesystem, recordings, worker startup and counters
coverage.evidence: qualification.prepare emits private immutable native-reviewed script; execute checks a real compute process; explicit native self-job lookup captures full attempt and owner on compute; collect uses fresh native detail and compares full identity, owner, nonce, required checks and actual errors
coverage.limits: Imports execute only when the user explicitly applies the generated native review. Every check reports passed/failed/unavailable independently. Process counters do not qualify scheduler accounting or per-job GPU attribution

coverage.requirement: Native qualification submission formats and bounded scheduler charges
coverage.evidence: Slurm srun step in reviewed sbatch script with pinned working/output directories; native PBS/LSF/Flux scripts; proper HTCondor submit description with queue1 and periodic_remove; explicit Kubernetes image, mounted output, one container, no automatic retry/restart and bounded requests/limits/deadline
coverage.limits: LSF and Flux portable memory requests are not expressible by the current generic adapters and remain visibly unverified before apply and in later receipts; full qualification stays partial until site limits are reviewed

coverage.requirement: Qualification identity is attempt-safe on Kubernetes and batch systems
coverage.evidence: Exact compute-observed native attempt and owner must match fresh collection detail and authority digest; Kubernetes DownwardAPI namespace, Job controller UID, distinct Pod UID; matching name or numeric ID alone is insufficient; Flux F58 IDs normalize to lossless decimal; HTCondor runtime macro yields exact Cluster.Proc
coverage.limits: Absent compute native tools/permissions or runtime linkage returns unverified. Hashes/nonces provide integrity and accidental mismatch detection, not remote attestation. Immutable per-state receipts support nonterminal-to-terminal recovery without overwriting evidence

coverage.requirement: Heavy compute ownership and retained native trace identity across every scheduler
coverage.evidence: Probe reports non-Slurm worker-startup and retained trace readiness unavailable; it never bypasses Slurm's placement/ownership verifier
coverage.block: Heavy ownership verification and retained recording protocol currently use Slurm native identities
coverage.unblock: Implement scheduler-specific verified allocation/container ownership, revocation/reconnect lifecycle, and versioned recording identity migration before enabling those capabilities; then qualify actual sites

coverage.requirement: Production SSH, live scheduler, GPU-family and multi-node qualification
coverage.evidence: The package's tests intentionally execute no scheduler jobs and use no physical GPU
coverage.block: No credentials/representative scheduler and accelerator hardware were supplied for these production sites
coverage.unblock: Explicitly apply reviewed probe jobs at each target site and retain identity-bound receipts; qualify driver/provider and multi-node conditions separately

coverage.requirement: Research output companions retain underlying data, units, filters, calculations, exact native identity, source coverage and uncertainty
coverage.evidence: provenance.build/write/load; immutable private companions; unknown numeric data remains null; finite/bounded rows; exact declaration and native evidence scope checks
coverage.limits: A companion digest does not validate the scientific calculation or establish source truth

coverage.requirement: Use existing immutable exports instead of duplicating or rewriting raw evidence
coverage.evidence: provenance.from_export verifies COMPLETE marker, manifest hash, CSV hash, exact single exported run/attempt, job ID, source units; applies typed exact-decimal filters; preserves integer cells beyond 2^53; retains every selected row; leaves original bundle unchanged
coverage.limits: 2 MiB input CSV and 20000 scanned rows; requests a smaller explicit range instead of silent sampling. Original legacy identity and caller-selected native identity remain separate under a typed unverified association with status partial. An exact persisted experiment link can be resolved as recorded-link but does not become independent scheduler attestation

coverage.requirement: Comparison compatibility and native profiler semantics
coverage.evidence: provenance.compare blocks mismatched units/calculation/filters, reports differing identities/sources/coverage/clocks, refuses verified legacy-native lineage claims and warns on unknown clock alignment; existing evidence/evidence_formats receipts preserve native imports
coverage.limits: Compatible metadata is not scientific equivalence; sampled traces are not hardware ground truth; imported Slurm receipts additionally require matching connection scope

coverage.requirement: Automatic provenance companion creation for every existing UI chart/export destination
coverage.evidence: Existing data_export already preserves CSV/units/source watermarks/hashes/attempt metadata; new companion services are explicit user actions in the shared Engineering CLI/TUI registry
coverage.block: The new opt-in helper does not automatically attach a calculation/selection companion to every legacy UI chart
coverage.unblock: Thread exact chart selection and calculation context through each chart export producer and preserve behavioral tests; this is an integration/code requirement, not an external hardware prerequisite

design_tradeoffs: Reused anchored project storage and bounded native transports rather than a new database, credential manager or background polling daemon; CAS protects concurrent preference edits
An explicit workspace and selected-site reads are simpler and cheaper than continuous cross-cluster discovery; per-site freshness and unavailable balances remain visible
Tiny reviewed compute probes provide stronger readiness evidence than executable presence while retaining a separate review/apply boundary and bounded resource cost
Original immutable exports and native receipts remain the authoritative evidence; provenance companions add bounded selected data and semantics without mutating source bundles
